text:
maria: Quick sync — webinar Apr 7. Need final X + LinkedIn cadence, hero assets (landscape + square), two bench hooks, and SDR routing plan. Can we keep social to 3 main pushes + post-webinar follow ups? :calendar:

sam: Yep. I'll write: Hook A (cost/latency) + Hook B (reliability/fallbacks) and 3 thread openers by EOD.

jess: Creative can do hero_land.jpg, hero_sq.jpg, and a simple GIF of routing fallback. ETA Mon afternoon. If delayed, we'll use text-only with a screenshot fallback.

leo: Routing: all promo links must have UTMs so CRM can attribute. Proposed: utm_medium=social, utm_source=x_or_li, utm_campaign=webinar_apr7, utm_content={variant}. SDR queue label = social_webinar.

sdr-triage: Acknowledged. We'll auto-tag intake and escalate anyone with >1 engagement. Provide sample intake fields and escalation rules please.

tina: Growth: small paid boost ok if organic numbers look thin. recommend reserve $500 for first 48h post-webinar.

maria: Nice. Sam, can you split copy into short X openers + longer LI blurbs? Keep the X lines punchy.

sam: Drafts:
- Hook A short: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses."
- Hook B short: "Keep LLM features online at scale."
LI blurb A/B longer versions ready in Drive.

jess: Also include alt text for images and a 1-line caption for the GIF. I'll upload files to Figma + Drive and paste links here.

leo: Tentative schedule:
- Apr 1 09:00 PT: Teaser (X + LI)
- Apr 3 11:00 PT: Thread deep-dive (X org)
- Apr 6 10:00 PT: Reminder (X + LI)
- Apr 7 09:00 & 12:00 PT: Live day pushes (X)
Post-webinar: Apr 8 highlight thread + on-demand link.

ops-bot: @frontend-team Please add marketing pixel flag to webinar reg page. Ticket WEB-3421 created.

sam: Example scheduler snippet for ops to copy:
POST Apr 3 11:00 PT / Channel: X (org) / Variant: A / Image: hero_land.jpg / Copy: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses. Register -> [link]?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr7&utm_content=A"
Reply 1 (11:05) / Copy: "Benchmarks: ~30% lower per-token cost on tail workloads. Register: [link]"

maria: Good. Also prepare 2 DM templates: 1) for commenters -> on-demand, 2) for heavy eng commenters -> SDR outreach. Add to playbook.

jess: Confirm asset delivery timeline: mockups Mon pm, final Tue am.

leo: I'll validate UTM ingestion and webhook mapping Wed and confirm.

sdr-triage: SDR snippets + intake fields by Wed.

tina: I'll lock the $500 amplification hold and share ad copy recommendations.

maria: Final checklist: 1) assets uploaded, 2) hooks A/B finalized, 3) scheduler entries with UTMs, 4) SDR playbook snippets, 5) DM templates, 6) growth budget confirm. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

sam: ✅

jess: ✅ (uploading shortly)

leo: ✅

sdr-triage: ✅ (snippets incoming)

tina: ✅ (budget reserved)

maria: Thanks team — I'll compile the playbook and post the final schedule here. :rocket:
